sn1.79:1.1: Kiṃsu bandhati pātheyyaṃ || kiṃsu bhogānam āsayo || kiṃsu naraṃ parikassati || kiṃsu lokasmiṃ dujjahaṃ || kismiṃ baddhā puthusattā || pāsena sakunī yathā ti || ||
sn1.79:2.1: Saddhā bandhati pātheyyam || siri bhogānam āsayo || icchā naram parikassati || icchā lokasmiṃ dujjahā || icchābaddhā puthusattā || pāsena sakuṇī yathā ti || ||
